scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:assets && npm run build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @book-landings/landing-core && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/landing-content && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/landing-seo && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/landing-sitelen && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/landing-ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @book-landings/ukrainian-modernism && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/toki-free-kit && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/dao-toki && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/stoic-wisdom-series && npm run build --workspace @book-landings/agro-library
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck --workspace @book-landings/ukrainian-modernism && npm run typecheck --workspace @book-landings/toki-free-kit && npm run typecheck --workspace @book-landings/dao-toki && npm run typecheck --workspace @book-landings/stoic-wisdom-series && npm run typecheck --workspace @book-landings/agro-library
scripts.dev:ukrainian-modernism: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @book-landings/ukrainian-modernism
scripts.dev:toki-free-kit: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @book-landings/toki-free-kit
scripts.dev:dao-toki: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @book-landings/dao-toki
scripts.dev:stoic-wisdom-series: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @book-landings/stoic-wisdom-series
scripts.dev:agro-library: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @book-landings/agro-library
